signals.topic: Playful maximalism: animal rugs & all-colour rooms
signals.summary: Exuberant, colour-saturated interiors — animal-shaped rugs, rooms that use 'every colour you can imagine', and over-the-top styling — pushing back on quiet minimalism.
signals.why_now: Two Apartment Therapy features within a day (animal-shaped rugs ~19h; a 'every colour' Dutch apartment ~21h) plus Yahoo on the over-the-top dorm-decor trend taking over TikTok (~16h) from an independent outlet.

signals.summary: Renewed appetite for furniture that reads as old — new collections styled to look like rare antiques, and 1980s silhouettes returning as current design.
signals.why_now: Two independent sources within a day: Apartment Therapy on Arhaus furniture 'that looks just like rare antiques' (~22h) and Interior Daily on Bette Midler's 1980s rocking chair returning as a 2026 design trend (~4h).
